capabilities: Convert typed date phrases like "tomorrow" or "next week" into periodic note links
Create missing periodic notes immediately with templates and folder structure applied
Detect the current note type from its filename format
Recognize written numbers, relative phrases, and weekday-specific phrases
Configure phrase toggles, note creation mode, and work scope in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.11.0 or higher. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Works with Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin and the Periodic Notes community plugin
problem: Obsidian's periodic notes don't auto-link related notes, so users must manually create and link daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Works with Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin and the Periodic Notes community plugin

requires.name: Daily Notes core plugin or Periodic Notes community plugin

summary: Natural-language linker that turns date phrases typed in periodic notes into links to the matching daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly note.
